result.summary: Found 2 issues: overlapping restaurant metadata on a popular card and a missing frameReferences field required by the schema.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery-time text ('25–30') overlaps the word 'delivery', making the metadata unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Give the time and 'delivery' labels separate layout space (or wrap/truncate) so they never collide.

issues.description: The second popular card shows a '-20%' badge but no restaurant name, rating, or other details are visible in the current viewport crop of that card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card metadata sits below the image with enough padding so it isn’t clipped when the card is partially in view, or confirm this is only viewport cropping.
